A note on what the picks are built from and where the gaps are:


The Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's toddler class (18 months - 3 years) is described as being for the toddler who loves to be on the move, with parent participation, led by a coach through structured warm-up, games, music, and circuits on gymnastic events.
 
The Fall Session runs Sept 10 - Dec 16 (no classes Oct 10)
, which fits the September-to-December window asked about.

On registration: 
the club's homepage states the Fall Rec Program begins September 12th, with registration beginning July 20th
 — meaning registration is already open as of today. I did not carry a price forward for this specific class, since the pricing shown alongside it on the club's site appeared tied to a separate drop-in program rather than this registered session, and I don't want to hand over a figure that might not actually apply.

I did not find a second gymnastics or parent-and-tot program elsewhere in Halton Hills (e.g., through the Town's own recreation site) with enough concrete detail — a day, time, or session date — to include confidently; the Town's children's programs page referenced toddler offerings only in general terms without specifics for this age band and season.
